title: Reverse a String
problem_statement: Read one line of text and print its characters in reverse order. Spaces and punctuation are characters and must be preserved. An empty line represents the empty string and should produce an empty output line.
constraints: The input contains between 0 and 100000 printable ASCII characters, inclusive.
The input may contain spaces and punctuation but no line-break characters.
input_format: Exactly one line containing the string to reverse. The line may be empty; a blank line represents the empty string. Spaces on the line are part of the input.
output_format: Print the input characters in reverse order on one line. Preserve all spaces and punctuation. For an empty input line, print an empty line.
starter_code:
def main():
    text = input()

    # TODO: Create the characters in reverse order without losing spaces.
    reversed_text = text
    print(reversed_text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

public_samples.explanation: The letters of `hello` appear in reverse order as `olleh`.
The space, digit, and punctuation mark are reversed along with the letters.
The empty string has no characters, so reversing it still produces an empty line.
Spaces are retained as characters while the whole line is reversed.

hints: The task changes the order of characters, not their values.
A string can be viewed as a sequence of characters with positions. Consider what happens to the first and last positions when reversing.
Python supports constructing a reversed string from an existing string using slicing or another string operation; make sure you apply it to the full input line.
common_beginner_mistakes: Reversing the order of words instead of reversing every character.
Dropping spaces or punctuation while rebuilding the string.
Using `text.reverse()`, which is not a string method and would not return a reversed string.
Printing the original text instead of the reversed result.
Treating the empty line as missing input rather than as an empty string.
Adding separators between characters even though the output should contain the reversed original characters.
completion_criteria: Reads exactly one input line and preserves spaces and punctuation.
Prints every input character in reverse order.
Prints an empty line for an empty input line.
Does not add spaces, labels, or other characters not present in the input.
Passes all public samples and separately maintained private tests.
